definitions.explanation: A song officially adopted by a country as its symbol. Japan's national anthem is {君|きみ}が{代|よ}.

examples.japanese: {国歌|こっか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧。
⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{国歌|こっか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: Before the match, the national anthems of both countries were played.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表彰式|ひょうしょうしき}→表彰式：20175_hyoushoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{国歌|こっか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: Hearing her country's anthem at the Olympic medal ceremony, the athlete wept.

notes:
{国|こく} (country) + {歌|か} (song); koku shortens to kok- before ka.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国歌|こっか}{斉唱|せいしょう}: singing the national anthem in unison
- {国歌|こっか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: the anthem is played
- ⟦{国旗|こっき}→国旗：19216_kokki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{国歌|こっか}: the national flag and anthem

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧: the state, a nation — same reading, far more common in writing
